anomaly_label: Increased distillate flow to distillate receiver (V003)

evidence.observation: Heater T701 climbs steadily 273.9→278.5 °C while reboiler T703 stays flat at ~50.4 °C — heat input not transferring to the vessel
Reboiler temperature static ~50.3-50.4 °C for 21 min, no boil-up
Column dP ~1.1-1.5 mbar, essentially no vapour traffic
Top/section temperatures flat ~36 °C, no separation front developing

args.missing_evidence: Reboiler level/fill status and heater power setpoints, to distinguish a dry/under-filled reboiler or poor thermal contact from a T703 thermocouple fault; a composition sample would show whether any separation occurred.
